description: The WHO Trial Registration Data Set for one trial from any registry the WHO ICTRP covers, by its registry id (e.g. "ChiCTR2400080001", "CTRI/2024/01/061234", "IRCT20230101056789N1", "DRKS00031234", "jRCT2031230001", "NCT06123456", "ACTRN12626001215314"): source registry and its record URL, titles, primary sponsor, recruitment status, study type and design, phase, countries of recruitment, conditions, interventions, primary and secondary outcomes, eligibility (criteria, age range, sex), target sample size, dates, funding sources, secondary ids, ethics review status. Contact-person details are not returned.

trial_id.description: Registry trial id as the source registry writes it, e.g. "ChiCTR2400080001".

name: ictrp_trial
